summary: The CertificationEditAll component is a web-based user control designed to manage the editing of certification records in a system. It provides functionalities to view, edit, and save certification details for students within an enrollment module.
purpose: To facilitate the management and editing of student certification details within a larger enrollment system, providing administrative users with tools to update certifications efficiently.

workflows.name: Save Certification Details
steps: Iterate through grid rows to check 'isDirty' state
If 'isDirty', update certification details for the student
Set redirect flag based on error messages
If redirect, navigate to Enrollment page with query parameters

business_rules: If in Add or single Edit mode, hide the Save All button
If EnrollmentID is zero, make certain header controls invisible based on conditions
If less than 14 rows, hide Save All and Cancel buttons
validations: Expiry Date must be on or after Effective Date
system_behavior: Loads student certifications from the database if not already loaded
Disables certain user interface elements if blnReadOnly is true
Binds grid data during data selection
exceptions: Cancel data loading if UserSession is null
